Can your provide more information about the issue and any additional steps you've taken to troubleshoot the issue. This will help narrow down where the issue may be. At the moment there are many possible reasons.

  2. Tap next.

Does this step report any errors

content:
New folders should be created using gmail's web-mail in the browser. Creating them directly in Thunderbird for Android is not supported.

Once created, they will be available in Thunderbird for Android after refreshing its folder list.

To do this ...

  1. Open the side menu with your gmail folders displayed.
  2. Tap manage folders (bottom of the list).
  3. Tap the three dot ፧ menu > refresh folders.

Folder creation is a feature requested by the community of Mozilla connect. You can show support by voting for this at the link below.

https://connect.mozilla.org/t5/ideas/add-the-ability-to-create-imap-folders-on-android/idi-p/72777
